notes: The agent-door measured round (docs/AGENT_CLI.md, the plan's P3). Each brief is what a user would type to their coding agent. `kind` noacg = a NoaCG graphic package; ograf = answered as a hand-written third-party OGraf Graphic (no NoaCG template). `type`/`chassis` feed arms B and C (null = the arm does not apply and the cell is recorded n/a). `expect` is what the runner checks mechanically; `judge` is what the blind owner read looks at. Ids are stable - records key off them.

A.label: contract-only skill, free design
A.hypothesis: the default: the agent authors the sources from scratch against the contract

B.label: A + the NEUTRAL type scaffold
B.hypothesis: the type's fields, machine and runtime on a plain spine; the agent designs on it

C.label: A + a catalog chassis
C.hypothesis: a proven composition to restyle; does the agent keep or fight it

D.label: A + the frontend-design skill
D.hypothesis: a design skill owns the look; NoaCG binds only for correctness/editability/compatibility/playout

E.label: A + the optional NoaCG design notes
E.hypothesis: does house guidance help or hurt a coding agent

briefs.prompt: A lower third for a public-broadcast evening news programme: the speaker's name and their role. Calm and authoritative, nothing decorative. It must carry a very long name - 'Alexandra Konstantopoulos-Vandermeulen', 'Senior European Economics Correspondent' - without wrapping badly or leaving the panel.
briefs.judge: airable as a news strap; long-name behaviour; hierarchy name > role

briefs.prompt: A football scoreboard for a school channel's live stream: two team names, two scores the operator bumps live, a visible 'goal' flag moment for either side the operator can trigger and clear, and a 'final' look when the match ends. Sits top-left, out of the way of the pitch.
briefs.judge: readable scores at a glance; the goal flag and final state exist and are operable; long team names

briefs.prompt: A 'lecture begins in' countdown for a university's stream: a label the operator writes ('Introduction to Broadcast Graphics begins in') and the minutes they set; the operator can pause and resume it live. Full-width holding look, readable from the back of a lecture hall.

stress.f0: Introduction to Broadcast Graphics and Interactive Playout begins in

briefs.judge: the clock runs and reads; pause/resume operable; the label survives a long value

briefs.prompt: An audience vote graphic: the question and three to five answer options with live percentages the operator updates during the show; the leading option visibly ahead. Lower half of the frame, leaves room for the presenter.

stress.f0: Which of the three proposals should the student union bring to the board this semester?
stress.f1: A longer, more elaborate answer option the presenter would read in full|A second long option that competes|Third

briefs.judge: five options still fit; percentages read; the lead is visible

briefs.prompt: A two-speaker debate clock for a school debating stream: each speaker's name and their remaining speaking time in seconds, the ACTIVE speaker's clock counting down; a 'switch speaker' action that pauses the current speaker and starts the other; a 'penalty' action that takes ten seconds off the active speaker; a 'reset' action that puts both clocks back to their set time. The operator must be able to run the whole debate from NoaCG's control panel without touching code.
briefs.judge: OPERABLE WITHOUT CATEGORY CODE: does `noacg inspect` show the switch/penalty/reset actions, and do they work from the panel; is it airable

briefs.prompt: Answer this as a plain, hand-written OGraf v1 Graphic package - an `.ograf.json` manifest plus the Web Component module - NOT as a NoaCG template: a 'now playing' music bug for a radio station's video stream: artist, song title and a 0-100 progress the controller updates; a custom action 'nextTrack' that clears the bug to the next values; one step. It must pass `noacg validate` as a third-party OGraf package (the host drives load / update / nextTrack / play / stop) and `noacg inspect` must derive its operator surface from the manifest alone.

stress.artist: Panagiotis Oikonomopoulos & The Northern Lights Orchestra
stress.song: A Very Long Song Title That Keeps Going (Extended Radio Edit)

briefs.judge: the OGraf contract alone yields the operator surface; the host lifecycle answers 2xx; airable
